page.layout: One printed page. Running head at the top ("EPISTOLA"). One text column in the centre-right, with a narrow marginal note column on the left holding the reference "2. Sa. 20.18." beside the first lines. Catchword "ad" at the lower right, below the last line. Signature "A 3" at the lower left of the foot rule.

main_text.p: cissimum sacri belli exitum pollicentur: Memineris vero inprimis interrogare (quod soles) Abelæos: Allachrymare, obsecra, & Deum atque homines contestans, hostem germanam miserè deperditam, per suam ipsius animam, per charissima Christi viscera, per pretiosissimos illos sanguinei sudoris grumulos, per commune denique æternæ redemptionis precium, vel de geniculis obtestare, ut ad

page.notes: The text is in italic type throughout. The marginal reference "2. Sa. 20.18." is printed beside the first lines of the column. The long s is transcribed as plain s. The catchword "ad" is set at the lower right. The signature "A 3" is faint at the foot. Some ink and show-through from the reverse page appear in the margins and are omitted.
